Main entrance.author: ThrillZing
Main entrance.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP.
Main entrance.verification: Commons file viewed 23 November 2026. LicenseShortName is CC BY 4.0, author ThrillZing, taken 10 March 2021, described as the Park Entrance gate with the Sky Tower behind it at SeaWorld Orlando. Direct inspection of the original (3024 by 4032) shows the SeaWorld Orlando Park Entrance arch, hanging baskets, and the tip of the Sky Tower. A child in a green shirt is seen from behind; other visitors are in the midground and are not the subject. No recognizable children's faces. No overlays or watermarks. Cropped from the lower portion of the portrait original to 1280 by 853. No upscaling.

Mako and Manta.verification: Commons file viewed 23 November 2026. LicenseShortName is CC BY 4.0, author ThrillZing, taken 10 March 2021, described as Manta's track sweeping over the lagoon at SeaWorld Orlando. Direct inspection of the original (4032 by 3024) shows the blue Orlando Manta layout over the ride's lagoon, with flowers in the foreground and no people. Sesame Street Christmas Parade.verification: Commons file viewed 23 November 2026. LicenseShortName is CC0, author HyenaWaltz, taken 11 January 2024, categorized under SeaWorld Orlando and Big Bird. Direct inspection of the original (4160 by 3120) shows the Sunny Day Carousel sign with Big Bird, which marks Sesame Street Land. Two distant figures under the canopy are not recognizable. Public ice skating at Bayside Stadium.alt: Bayside Stadium across the lagoon at SeaWorld Orlando, with blue seating, a roof, and fountain jets in the water
Public ice skating at Bayside Stadium.caption: Bayside Stadium at SeaWorld Orlando, seen across the lagoon. Public ice skating is held here during the Christmas Celebration. The skating itself is not pictured.
Public ice skating at Bayside Stadium.author: Adog104
Public ice skating at Bayside Stadium.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
Public ice skating at Bayside Stadium.verification: Commons file viewed 23 November 2026. LicenseShortName is CC BY-SA 4.0, author Adog104, taken 22 September 2018, described as the facade of Bayside Stadium at SeaWorld Orlando. Direct inspection of the original (4032 by 3024) shows the stadium across the lagoon with fountain jets, empty stands, and no people. It is a daytime place photo; the ice rink is not in the frame. SeaWorld's 2026 shows page puts public ice skating at Bayside Stadium. Cropped slightly from the top of the 4:3 original to 1280 by 853. No upscaling.

Holiday Reflections.alt: Fireworks bursting over water fountains on the lagoon at SeaWorld Orlando at night
Holiday Reflections.caption: Fireworks and fountains on the lagoon at SeaWorld Orlando, the same lagoon used for Holiday Reflections. Photographed in July 2007, not during the current holiday show.
Holiday Reflections.author: Matt Keefe
Holiday Reflections.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP.
Holiday Reflections.verification: Live Flickr page viewed 23 November 2026. Title is More Fireworks, author Matt Keefe (username M. Keefe), taken 14 July 2007, license ID 4 (CC BY 2.0) with the Creative Commons BY 2.0 deed on the page. A related photo in the same set, Bright Rockets, describes a nightly SeaWorld fireworks show similar to Illuminations at Epcot, which places the set in Orlando. Direct inspection shows fireworks and lagoon fountains at night, with only silhouettes in the foreground and no recognizable faces. Native size is 1280 by 960; cropped to 1280 by 853. No upscaling. This is not a photograph of the named 2026 Holiday Reflections show.
